replication.page.title: Replication
replication.page.description: Send hosted components to another Astrum server. A remote is the receiving server; a replication copies one hosted repository to one repository of a remote.
replication.remotes.name: Name
replication.remotes.deleteText: A remote that a replication uses cannot be deleted. The server names the replications that use it.
replication.remote.name: Name
replication.remote.urlHint: https with no path, for example https://astrum.example.com:8443
replication.remote.tokenKept: Token is set, leave empty to keep it
replication.remote.tokenReason: The URL changed, so the token must be entered again
replication.remote.trustStoreText: Trust the SSL certificates of the trust store when connecting to this remote
replication.remote.privateNetworkText: Lets this remote resolve to private addresses
replication.remote.privateNetworkWarning: Allows RFC 1918, ULA and 100.64.0.0/10 addresses for this remote only; loopback and link-local stay refused
replication.remote.concurrencyHint: Components sent at the same time, from 1 to 16
replication.replications.name: Name
replication.replications.deleteText: Components already sent stay on the remote.
replication.replication.name: Name
replication.replication.remoteRepository: Repository on the remote that receives the components; it must exist there
replication.replication.nameFilterHint: Regular expression that must match the whole namespace/name, or the name when there is no namespace. Empty means all.
replication.replication.versionFilterHin: Regular expression that must match the whole version. Empty means all.
replication.replication.invalidPattern: This is not a valid pattern in the browser. The server decides when you save.
replication.replication.serverSyntax: The server reads these as Rust regular expressions; exotic patterns can match differently here.
replication.replication.previewNoSource: Choose a source repository to see which components match
replication.replication.previewEmpty: The source repository has no components yet
replication.replication.previewTitle: {count} components of {repository} checked against the filters
replication.replication.propagateDeletes: Send deletes of components to the remote
A delete here removes the component on the remote too. Turn this on for disaster recovery copies, not for delivery.
replication.replication.settleHint: Wait this long after a change before sending, so signatures pushed right after a tag travel with it. 0 to 3600.
replication.replication.reconcileHint: Compare the repository with the remote at this interval. At least 5.
replication.replication.channelsHint: Notification channels told when the replication fails
replication.replication.channelsError: The notification channels could not be loaded
replication.validation.url: Use an address such as https://astrum.example.com:8443, with no path, user name, query or fragment
replication.validation.urlHttps: Use https, or http only when private network addresses are allowed
replication.validation.tokenRequired: Enter the token: the URL is new or the token is not stored
replication.validation.token: Use no spaces and no non-ASCII characters
replication.validation.range: Enter a whole number from {min} to {max}
replication.validation.atLeast: Enter a whole number of at least {min}
replication.validation.positive: Enter a number above 0, or leave empty for no limit
replication.validation.repository: Use letters, digits, '-', '_' and '.', starting with a letter, a digit or '-'
